meta.name: article-illustrator
meta.description: 内容创作者和自媒体创作者在撰写长文时，当需要“给文章配图”或“添加插图”时使用。自动分析文章结构，精准识别需要视觉辅助的位置，生成并插入契合语境的插画，将抽象概念具象化，一键完成高质量图文排版，大幅提升阅读体验。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为长文自动生成贴切插画，提升阅读体验
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果写长文时总为配图发愁
copy.tagline_en: Automatically generate fitting illustrations for articles to enhance reading.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often struggle to find images for your articles.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会读你的长文,逐段找出需要配图的位置,先给出配图计划,再生成插画并用 Markdown 语法插到对应段落之后,图片存到文章目录下的 imgs/ 文件夹,最后汇报成功张数和每张图的位置。
howto.when: 当你明确说“给文章配图”、“为文章生成插图”等要求时触发;通常在撰写长文、需要视觉辅助时进入。

say.text: 给这篇文章配图,文件在 ./draft.md
say.note: 先读文件,再逐段规划并生成插画

say.text: 为这篇文章生成插图,风格用科幻未来感
say.note: 同一篇内保持风格一致

say.text: 帮我给这篇长文添加配图
say.note: 按章节识别位置并插入图片

howto.what_en: Claude reads your long article, finds sections needing visuals, drafts an illustration plan, generates images, and inserts them with Markdown syntax into matching paragraphs. Images go to an imgs/ folder beside the article.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you explicitly ask to illustrate an article or generate images for it, e.g. "illustrate this article". Typically used while drafting a long piece that needs visual support.

say_en.text: Illustrate this article; the file is at ./draft.md
say_en.note: Reads the file, then plans and generates images

say_en.text: Generate illustrations for this article in a sci-fi style
say_en.note: Style stays consistent within the article

say_en.text: Add illustrations to this long-form article
say_en.note: Finds spots per section and inserts them
